content: We proposed Human Level Attributes (HLAs) as a novel approach to model human-like attributes of characters, and collected a large volume of dialogue data for various characters with complete and robust profiles. We also proposed and evaluated a system, ALOHA, that uses HLAs to recommend tailored responses traceable to specific characters, and demonstrated its outperformance of the baselines and ability to effectively recover language styles of various characters, showing promise for learning character or personality styles. ALOHA was also shown to be stable regardless of the character's identity, genre of show, and context of dialogue.
